about: Catalogue expansion for the beta. Facts (year, length, credits) were compiled from general knowledge; where an open source matches a work, its values replace these and the change is recorded (fact_sources). Terms, advisories and summaries are AI-assisted readings awaiting editorial review. Ratings are unverified.

works.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
works.summary: Link wakes after a hundred years to a ruined Hyrule he can explore in any direction, climbing anything he can see.
ratings: Fantasy violence, mild suggestive themes, use of alcohol

works.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
works.summary: A boy from the forest travels through time to stop a desert king from seizing the Triforce.

works.title: Super Mario Odyssey
works.summary: Mario chases Bowser's wedding plans across themed kingdoms with a sentient hat that lets him possess enemies.

works.title: Super Mario Bros.
works.summary: A plumber runs and jumps through the Mushroom Kingdom's eight worlds to rescue Princess Toadstool from Bowser.

works.title: Minecraft
works.summary: Survive the night, then build anything you can imagine, block by block, in an endless generated world.

works.title: Tetris
works.summary: Falling shapes, a rising stack, and the satisfaction of a cleared line.

works.title: Portal 2
works.summary: A test subject wakes in a decaying research facility, to the delight of the vengeful AI who runs it.

works.title: Half-Life 2
